subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into segments. One of them may contain an error. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

A shop nearby / sell all the goods / of daily use.
solution:
The erroneous segment is "**sell all the goods**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the **subject-verb agreement** is incorrect.
 
• The plural verb "sell" does not agree with the subject "A shop"
 
• The correct verb form will be "**sells**"

**The correct sentence is**:* A shop nearby **sells **__all the goods of daily use.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
